body.intent: Builders and fixers run the leaf's acceptance commands and the project's generate and render before their one commit, fold what they change into it, and report each command with its exit code in the commit; verifiers re-run what was reported. Evidence: 29 of 160 verifier blocker/major findings were generated, golden, format or self-check misses and 10 were commit, trailer or actor shape (prompt-gap rec 1).
body.title: Pre-handoff checklist
